newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end down, profit taking seen.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end down, profit taking seen.

text.p: Singappore shares finished lower on Friday with profit taking seen in index-stocks after recent sharp gains. The key Straits Times Industrials Index fell 18.23 points to 2,187.86.

Singapore Telecom shares continue to be active with some 20 million shares changing hands seen. The volume accounted for about 18 percent of total market turnover of 108.82 million shares. SingTel ended down two cents to S$3.14 , SingTel 100 and SingTel 10 both ended four cents lower at S$3.12.
Brokers said investors focussed mostly on Malaysian second liners and speculative issues.
"There is no fresh news but there is plenty of stories on the Malaysian second board," said one dealer with a local firm.
Trading and property company United Industrial Corp was active falling S$0.01 to S$1.24. A dealer said some houses are calling a sell on the stock.
Food-based Cerebos led the losers, down S$0.30 at S11.50. SIA foreign, Singapore Press Holdings, DBS foreign and Fraser & Neave ended weaker.
Orchard Parade, Jurong Shipyard and DBS ended firmer.
